sources.name: Dezeen
sources.summary: British designer duo Isabel Gibson and Helen Chesner have filled The Conran Shop's gallery with colourful, kinetic models for their London Design Festival exhibition, Motion Sickness. Spinning orbs, flapping wings and wheeled devices all feature in the exhibition, which marks 10 years since the founding of their London-based art and design studio, Isabel + Helen. The post Isabel + Helen showcase their "obsession with movement" with kinetic models at The Conran Shop appeared first on Dezeen .
